data.name: Nava
data.gender_notes: Nava is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Hebrew, Nava means new. This name is derived from the Hebrew word 'nawah' which means rest or repose. In the Bible, Nava is mentioned in Numbers 26:51 as one of the daughters of Zelophehad who challenged the patriarchal law and gained the right for women to inherit land. The name Nava carries the meaning “New” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Nava usually hope their child will grow to embody new and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Nava belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “New.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Nava total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.
